method: All 300 listed activities in the three retrieved NYC B-13-MS-36-0001 Q4/Q12/Q20 QPR versions. Exact Location Description field enumeration plus local MiniLM retrieval and original-page checks. Borough names are geographic scope evidence, not financial weights. Citywide and multi-borough amounts stay on one activity record; no division, duplication or borough totals. Administrative-office locations are excluded. Neighborhood-only or unspecified locations remain unknown. Source-specific activity IDs may change; no inferred crosswalk to F31.
coverage_limit: This is three selected historical reporting periods for one NYC award, not all NYC awards/quarters or exhaustive borough project geography.
